policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: For the mixed red-and-green goal, finish the green quota before choosing red.
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: For mixed goals, select the next needed color according to the goal's quotas: for three blue and two green, complete green before blue; for two red and three green, complete green before red; for two red and one green, complete red before green. For the previously covered mixed red-and-green layout with the bin near [130, 117], retain green before red. These priorities govern A with an empty hand, not B for a cube already held.

policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: For the one-green goal select the initially visible green cube near [81, 153].
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: For the one-green goal select the initially visible green cube near [81, 153]. Additional target preferences apply only when both the goal and layout match: for three blue and two green with the bin near [90, 148], select green near [99, 82] or [118, 81] when green_deposited is respectively zero or one; after completing the green quota, select blue near [61, 171], [112, 152], or [88, 184] when blue_deposited is respectively zero, one, or two. For one red with the bin near [112, 177], select red near [79, 127]. For two red and three green with the bin near [94, 155], select green near [68, 178], [71, 75], or [90, 181] when green_deposited is respectively zero, one, or two; after completing the green quota, select red near [54, 99] or [100, 121] when red_deposited is respectively zero or one. For two blue with the bin near [122, 181], select blue near [91, 163] or [97, 117] when blue_deposited is respectively zero or one. For two red and one green with the bin near [107, 86], select red near [74, 98] or [64, 83] when red_deposited is respectively zero or one; after completing the red quota, select green near [105, 117]. Match these approximate locations to current visible free cubes of the selected color; use the fallback if a preferred candidate is absent.

edits.modify_from: Integer number of blue cubes successfully released into the bin by this decision step. Start at zero; increment at the first decision step following each completed blue-cube deposit, not at pickup or when issuing B. Preserve otherwise. Episode 8 values are 0,0,1,1,2; episode 60 values are 0,0,1,1,2,2,3; all other supplied episodes remain zero. e.g. 1
edits.modify_to: Cumulative integer number of blue cubes successfully released into the bin during execution by this decision step, in every episode. Start at zero; increment once at the first decision step following each completed blue-cube deposit, including the final deposit. Do not increment at pickup or when issuing B. Preserve otherwise; newly appearing free cubes do not cancel completed deposits. e.g. 1
